subject.title: fix(plugins): keep openclaw chunks native in jiti

question: Should OpenClaw's own package chunks be forced onto the native Node module graph whenever the plugin loader falls through to jiti-transformed execution?
rationale: The diff is small, but it changes the shared plugin-loader module-cache boundary for existing plugin execution paths, which is compatibility-sensitive and protected by the maintainer label.

options.title: Accept native OpenClaw chunks
options.body: Land this narrow option and test if maintainers agree duplicate OpenClaw dist evaluation is never a supported plugin behavior.

options.title: Ask for packaged marker proof
options.body: Keep the PR paused until a current packaged before/after run shows OpenClaw dist chunks evaluating once in the original CLI scenario.

options.title: Preserve jiti isolation
options.body: Close or redesign the PR if maintainers believe any supported plugin contract depends on OpenClaw chunks being evaluated inside jiti's cache.

recommendation.title: Accept native OpenClaw chunks
recommendation.body: Land this narrow option and test if maintainers agree duplicate OpenClaw dist evaluation is never a supported plugin behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the current PR and has recent history on the shared plugin jiti loader helpers affected by the decision.
